name: thanos_no_rule_evaluations
title: Thanos No Rule Evaluations
description: Thanos Rule did not perform any rule evaluations in the past 10 minutes.

source.upstream_query: sum by (job, instance) (rate(prometheus_rule_evaluations_total{job=~".*thanos-rule.*"}[5m])) <= 0  and sum by (job, instance) (thanos_rule_loaded_rules) > 0
source.upstream_description: Thanos Rule {{$labels.instance}} did not perform any rule evaluations in the past 10 minutes.
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (sum by (job, instance) (rate(prometheus_rule_evaluations_total{job=~".*thanos-rule.*"}[5m])) <= 0  and sum by (job, instance) (thanos_rule_loaded_rules) > 0) * 0 + 1
